title: Daily Chief Inspector Report
contractor: West Tech Energy — Jose Salaises, Director of Operations

sections.heading: Summary of the Day
paragraphs: Joel Schweers notified West Tech that Titan Operations will not allow a shutdown of the existing combustor for the fuel gas tie-in to the new flare. The fuel gas piping is being changed: Tegre is preparing new ISOs, a revised BOM and updated P&IDs. Joel issued the IFC ISO set with red lines through the affected spools. Those spools are on hold and must not be fabricated; ISOs without red lines may proceed.

Joel also confirmed Tegre is preparing the flare anchor bolt detail requested by West Tech. No field notes, Plaud recordings or West Tech daily report were available for today, so manpower, weld and progress data are not recorded.

rows: No safety information in today's sources.
